DISCLAIMERS:

*If other tickets also match all six numbers, the prize pool will be split into equal amounts among all winning tickets.
**Sales stop on draw nights at 6:59 PM Arizona time from the second Sunday in March through the first Saturday in November and at 7:59 PM Arizona time from the first Sunday in November through the second Saturday in March.
***Lottery numbers broadcasted on television or radio, published on the Arizona State Lottery website, or published and/or communicated by other means does not constitute an official representation of the actual winning lottery numbers. The Arizona State Lottery official audited records of numbers drawn will determine the winning numbers for any draw. A draw game prize must be claimed within 180 days of a drawing.
****Winning the Match 5 prize (all 5 white balls) still pays $2 million regardless of the multiplier number drawn. Power Play does not apply to the jackpot. Power Play does not apply to Double Play prizes.
*****The Power Play 10X feature will be available when the annuitized jackpot amount is $150,000,000 or less.
All sales are final. Drawing game tickets cannot be voided.

howToPlay:
HOW TO PLAY
POWERBALL
Step 1,
Pick Your Numbers

Choose Quick Pick and let the computer select the numbers for you, or select your own six numbers:

5 white numbers (1 – 69)
1 red Powerball number (1 – 26)

Add Power Play for $1 to multiply your winnings.****

Add Double Play for $1 for a chance to win up to $10,000,000 in a secondary drawing.

Step 2,
Buy Your Ticket

Powerball tickets cost $2 per game and can be purchased** at more than 3,000 Arizona Lottery Retailers.

Step 3,
Check Your Winnings

After the drawing occurs, match the numbers on your ticket to the winning numbers*** selected to see if you won!
